# Known answers for the Mach-O samples.
# Tools: LLVM 21.1.8, Python 3.14.8
# Date: 2026-10-07
# Method: check_pages.py --pages FILE (Python hashlib over the file as stored)
# and llvm-lipo -archs FILE. Page hashes are of the 4096-byte pages of each
# slice up to codeLimit. Input SHA-256 of every sample follows.
# sample tiny-macho-x86_64 6bd337c24619398dcb5f423fb0618444a8fba2fbc98fdd392f36f7bbf77f1929
# sample tiny-macho-arm64 38b903d98a75ec65a3b0918ac29bf9fedb8263715e62439d023f6e5fb17f2a9c
# sample tiny-macho-universal cb8ee911be4afa0306932fd17c30a158db637fc1ecdc328aa30f12d05a125651
# sample tiny-macho-arm64-adhoc cea933550c3e33e1ad699905e2852d8d01749267b2e776e5c25af6c975357a3c
# sample tiny-macho-x86_64-adhoc 85972bee45f12308d38e47ea61b3c826573d11f3308205b880aee5334ee1a153
# sample tiny-macho-universal-adhoc a401268d22e325244565aa4dc82e05228f2129b7e5837f8696db4041f4d1a376
# sample tiny-macho-x86_64-nospace fdb73e077dc3a3efa2e6d3b883847a2d8c75c68cc4f7da7924640d8c48fd1d92
# sample tiny-macho-x86_64-exactfit be615e75d8a0c008ee5c312866fb95bff49732598d543d50ecb47306ebb4defb
# sample tiny-macho-universal64 34252fb92f361d43e16a0a603fa74ac86687877e30ad6bac491ccf7274a3342c
# sample tiny-macho-dylib-arm64 30f424a90deac3397edcd0849e8f10806e315651efdc1056e02008de13350335
# sample tiny-macho-x86_64-data-after-sig b6cf227abc8610ac56af87b9ec6c1259b6fddcbaef319c3fb83a0efff1253c3e
== tiny-macho-x86_64
